resources.string: Take a look before you go
Tap a pin to see what’s there. Compare another place or close the card: your route stays as it is until you choose a destination or add a stop.
Tap a participating garage in Basel to see how many spaces are free and when the count was updated. If there’s no recent reading, the app tells you.
Your usual places, one tap away
Save Home or Work in a destination’s details. Open search to find them alongside your recently sent places, or tap the microphone to dictate a new one on supported phones.
